Hello! Welcome to my website.

My name is Md Mutasim Billah ([EM-DEE MUTAA-seem bi-LAH](https://namedrop.io/mdmutasimbillah)) and I use the pronouns he/him/his. 
I am a statistician and Full-time Lecturer at Case Western Reserve University in Cleveland, OH. 
I completed my PhD in Statistics at [Michigan Technological University](https://www.mtu.edu/math/) in Summer 2025. I also earned an M.Sc in Statistics from [Michigan Technological University](https://www.mtu.edu/math/) in 2023. Prior to that, I completed both a B.Sc. and M.Sc. in Statistics, Biostatistics, & Informatics from the [University of Dhaka](https://www.stat.du.ac.bd/), the top public university in Bangladesh.


In my personal life, I am a father of three wonderful children. Outside of my academic work, I enjoy spending time outdoors with my family and friends or cooking a variety of foods. If you
can’t find me anywhere, I might be busy playing soccer or exploring new worlds on PS5!

The picture on this page is from a July 2024 trip to [Pictured Rocks](https://www.munising.org/explore/pictured-rocks-national-lakeshore/?utm_source=google&utm_medium=cpc&utm_campaign=26MunisingSEM2025&utm_content=primary&utm_term=painted%20rocks%20mi&gad_source=1&gad_campaignid=22152321351&gbraid=0AAAAA-trJcY-pnCe7_NlqZxgfLHaIjnqk&gclid=Cj0KCQjwoP_FBhDFARIsANPG24NPrXVTutgquqp-JkUbzCehfGfqUNRfV373_wzNch8I1KOPYR-jRg8aAjPLEALw_wcB) at Munising, Michigan.
